core_problem_solved: To provide a powerful Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) solution for Java, bridging the gap between the object-oriented domain model of an application and a relational database.
key_features: Implements the Jakarta Persistence API (JPA) standard
Provides its own powerful native Session API for finer-grained control
Features a powerful query language (HQL - Hibernate Query Language)
Includes advanced features like caching (first and second level), lazy loading, and fetching strategies
era_and_niche: The core artifact for Hibernate ORM (up to version 5.x), the de facto industry standard for ORM and data persistence in the Java enterprise ecosystem for many years.
reason_for_obsolescence: While the Hibernate technology is a modern standard, this specific Maven coordinate is for an **older generation** of the library. With the move to Jakarta EE and the release of version 6+, the project's official groupId changed. The direct and actively maintained successor is **`org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-core`**.
